methodology: A multi-stage method involving color image improvement of the retina, applying a Gabor filter to produce images derived from the green channel, segmenting the green channel using U-Net++, extracting HOG and LBP features from binary images, and disease diagnosis using a one-dimensional convolutional neural network.
key_findings: For the DRIVE dataset, the accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, IOU, and F1-score were 98.9, 94.1, 98.8, 85.26, and 98.14, respectively. For the MESSIDOR dataset, accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity were 98.6, 99, and 98, respectively. The presented system outperforms manual approaches applied by skilled ophthalmologists and previous methods proposed in the MESSIDOR database.
